fields.climate: varies with altitude; humid and tropical to cold and semiarid
fields.terrain: rugged Andes Mountains with a highland plateau (Altiplano), hills, lowland plains of the Amazon Basin
fields.hazards: flooding in the northeast (March to April); volcanism: volcanic activity in Andes Mountains on the border with Chile…
fields.resources: lithium, tin, natural gas, petroleum, zinc, tungsten, antimony, silver, iron, lead, gold, timber, hydropower
fields.farm: sugarcane, soybeans, maize, potatoes, sorghum, rice, milk, chicken, plantains, beef
fields.exports: gold, natural gas, precious metal ore, zinc ore, soybean meal
fields.industries: mining, smelting, electricity, petroleum, food and beverages, handicrafts, clothing, jewelry
fields.languages: Spanish (official) 68.1%, Quechua (official) 17.2%, Aymara (official) 10.5%, Guarani (official) 0.6%, other 1.5%, unspecified 2.1%; note - Spanish and all Indigenous languages are official
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 65%, Protestant 19.6% (Evangelical (non-specific) 11.9%, Evangelical Baptist 2.1%, Evangelical Pentecostal 1.8%, Evangelical Methodist 0.7%, Adventist 2.8%, Protestant (non-specific)…
fields.legal: civil law system with influences from Roman, Spanish, canon (religious), French, and ethnic groups' pre-colonial law
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
fields.military: voluntary service for men and women 18-22 years of age; selective 12-month compulsory service for men, 18-22 (24 months of search and rescue service can be substituted for military service)
